description: Schedule events for workspace members and agents, and view scheduled plans.
calendarHint: Events for workspace members and agents.
name: Name
emptyHint: Create a calendar, then add events for workspace members or agents.
bookingHint: Schedule in {{zone}}. Overlapping events are checked again when saving.
invalidWallTime: This date or time is invalid, or falls in a daylight saving gap. Choose another time.
cancelHint: Cancelling releases this time and preserves the event history.
manageHint: People are shared within this workspace. Conflicts are checked across its calendars.
personZoneHint: Working hours and time off use this zone. Changes must preserve existing events.
archiveHint: History will be preserved. Reschedule or cancel all unfinished events first.
hoursHint: Zone: {{zone}}. Add multiple windows per day. Days without working hours cannot be booked.
fullDayHint: For a full day off, use 00:00–24:00 in the person’s time zone.
exceptionsRange: Showing time off for 31 days from the selected date.
noPeople: No members available. Refresh to try again.
availabilityHint: Availability is a snapshot and is rechecked when event.
selectPersonHint: Select a person to find availability.
calendarGrantsHint: Grant each calendar explicitly. Create does not include reading details; availability excludes customer information. Table permissions remain separate. Setting agent reminders requires both event update and agent trigger permissions. Event subscriptions require both subscribe and detail-read permissions. Delivery history and subscription management have separate grants. Keys can access only subscriptions they created.

errors.BAD_INPUT: Check the dates, time zone and input format.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The record is unavailable. Refresh and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: The record changed. Refresh before trying again. Your draft is preserved.
errors.RESOURCE_CONFLICT: This person has an overlapping event, or this change affects an existing event. Choose another time.
errors.OUTSIDE_AVAILABILITY: This time is outside working hours or overlaps time off. Choose another time.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH: This request key was used for different input. Start a new action.
errors.QUERY_LIMIT: Query limit exceeded. Reduce the date range or select fewer plans.
errors.ARCHIVED: The calendar or person is archived. Choose an active record.
errors.INVALID_STATE: The event status or linked membership changed. Refresh and try again.
errors.FUTURE_BOOKINGS: Reschedule or cancel unfinished events before archiving.
errors.REQUEST_FAILED: The request could not be completed. Check your connection and retry.
errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: Outbound delivery is not configured. Ask your administrator to check the integration encryption key.

reminders.title: Agent reminders
reminders.boundary: Reminders trigger an agent; they do not send email or SMS. Before-start reminders skip after the event starts or the lateness window expires; at-end reminders skip after that window. Rescheduling, cancelling or removing reminders invalidates unaccepted intents. Accepted runs may continue.
reminders.noAgents: Create an agent in your enterprise first.
reminders.promptHint: Wrap fields such as event.event.title or event.event.start in double braces. The agent runs in the event’s original workspace.
reminders.none: No reminders configured. Saving an empty list revokes unaccepted reminders.
reminders.acceptedAt: Accepted at {{at}}; later cancellation may not stop this run.

reasons.booking_revision_changed: Event or reminder settings changed; the old intent is superseded.
reasons.reminder_authorization_revoked: Creator, agent membership or original key permissions were revoked.
reasons.deadline_not_due: This reminder is not due yet.

plans.title: Scheduled plan
plans.hint: Edits change the original rule for subsequent triggers. Predicted points do not reserve staff time or prove execution. Missed points during downtime may coalesce into one run. Disabling prevents new starts; in-flight agents may continue.
plans.legend: Predicted and recorded points; no event occupancy
plans.delayed: This point is delayed; check the actual execution record.
plans.grantHint: Grant each rule explicitly. Calendar grants do not authorize plans or private conversations. Update grants only allow timing, name and enabled changes.

subscriptions.title: Calendar event subscriptions
subscriptions.description: Send calendar change notifications to your HTTPS endpoint.
subscriptions.adminOnly: Only owners and administrators can manage outbound subscriptions here.
subscriptions.noCalendarsHint: Open Calendar to create a calendar in this workspace, then return here.
subscriptions.emptyHint: Choose which changes your endpoint should receive.
subscriptions.boundary: Notifications contain IDs and versions only. Fetch details with separate API permissions. Changes to shared staff schedules notify every calendar in this workspace. Pausing or changing configuration skips unfinished deliveries; resuming starts with new events.
subscriptions.endpointHint: Use a public HTTPS address on port 443. Private addresses and redirects are rejected.
subscriptions.rotateHint: The old secret stops being used. Unfinished deliveries are skipped. Save the new secret before closing.
subscriptions.revokeHint: This permanently stops future deliveries. Requests already received by your endpoint cannot be withdrawn.
subscriptions.secretOnce: This secret is shown once. Use it to verify the request signature. If lost, rotate it.
subscriptions.secretLost: The request was already accepted. The secret cannot be shown again; rotate it to get a new one.
subscriptions.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select and copy the secret manually.
subscriptions.deliveryBoundary: Delivery may repeat or arrive out of order. Deduplicate by deliveryId/eventId and use aggregateVersion. Automatic retries stop after five attempts.
subscriptions.noDeliveries: No deliveries match this filter. Only events after subscription creation are delivered.

reasons.destination_rejected: Destination is blocked by outbound address restrictions.
reasons.timeout: The endpoint did not respond before the deadline.
reasons.response_too_large: The endpoint response exceeded the size limit.
reasons.http_error: The endpoint returned a non-success HTTP status.
reasons.outcome_unknown: The delivery result could not be confirmed. Your endpoint may have received this attempt.
reasons.subscription_changed: Subscription configuration changed; old deliveries were skipped.
reasons.authorization_revoked: The creator or original API key no longer has the required permissions.
reasons.invalid_event: The stored event format or scope is invalid; no request was sent.

chooseCalendar: Choose a calendar to view its events.
bookingSetupAdmin: Add a service person or link an existing member, then set their working hours. Days without working hours cannot be booked.
bookingSetupMember: Ask a workspace administrator to add a service person and working hours to this calendar. You can still view events and scheduled plans.
legacyHint: This historical event keeps its original person and working-hours restrictions.
